units: <cite ref="Exodus 7">Mishp. 7</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 28:23">Prov. XXVIII, 23</cite>) <he>כל המוכיח … זוכה לפ׳ של הקב״ה</he> he who reproves his neighbor for the sake of heaven, will be granted a share of divine grace; (<cite ref="Tamid 28a:17">Tam. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>לחלקו</he>).—Pl. <cite ref="Q00945"><he>פְּלַגּוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Gittin 89b:2">Gitt. 89ᵇ</cite> (borrowing the phrase from <cite ref="Judges 5:16">Jud. V, 16</cite>) <he>עדיין לא הגיע לפ׳ ראובן</he> he (that minor, although physically developed beyond his age) has not yet obtained ‘the parts of Reuben’ (mental maturity, and none will consider him an adult).
